general.title: MOSuite-filter
general.instructions: filter low counts in a multiOmicsDataSet

parameters.name: Group column name
parameters.description: Column from sample metadata containing sample group information (e.g. treatment, phenotype)

parameters.name: Minimum count value
parameters.description: Minimum count value to be considered non-zero for a sample

parameters.name: Minimum samples with nonzero counts (total)
parameters.description: Minimum number of samples (total) with non-zero counts

parameters.name: Use CPM for filtering
parameters.description: Transform raw counts to CPM before filtering
parameters.help_text: Set TRUE for raw counts, FALSE if counts are already normalized/transformed

parameters.name: Label column name
parameters.description: Column from sample metadata with labels for plots (e.g. shortened sample names)
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the sample ID column

parameters.name: Plot correlation heatmap
parameters.description: Create a correlation matrix heatmap for sample similarity
parameters.help_text: Set to FALSE for datasets with many samples to avoid long run times

parameters.name: Interactive plots
parameters.description: Create interactive plots with plotly (PCA and histogram)
parameters.help_text: Interactive plots allow hovering to view sample information, but correlation heatmap will not display

parameters.name: Minimum samples per group with nonzero counts
parameters.description: Only keeps genes that have at least this number of samples with nonzero counts in at least one group

parameters.name: Use group-based filtering
parameters.description: If TRUE, only keeps features that have sufficient nonzero counts in at least one group

parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: Type of counts to filter. Must be a count type in names(moo@counts)

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column name in the counts matrix containing feature IDs
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the first column by default

parameters.name: Sample ID column name
parameters.description: Column name in the sample metadata containing sample IDs
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the first column in the sample metadata by default
